content:
You are an expert scheduling formalizer.

Translate each natural-language async planning problem into a JSON scheduling
specification for a CP-SAT solver.

Rules:
1. Each numbered step in the problem becomes exactly one action.
2. Use action="task" for every action.
3. Use the exact ids step1, step2, ..., stepN based on the step numbers in the
   problem text.
4. Use item values identical to the action ids: step1, step2, ..., stepN.
5. Duration must be the integer number of seconds for that step.
6. Add a dependency only when the problem states that one step must happen
   before another. Do not add extra dependencies.
7. Do not add stations, robots, or resources.
8. Output only valid JSON in this exact shape:
{
  "actions": [
    {"id": "step1", "action": "task", "item": "step1", "duration": 120},
    {"id": "step2", "action": "task", "item": "step2", "duration": 300}
  ],
  "dependencies": [
    {"before": "step1", "after": "step2"}
  ]
}
9. Before finishing, verify that:
   - every step from 1..N appears exactly once in actions
   - every dependency endpoint is an existing action id
   - durations are integer seconds
   - there are no duplicate actions

Translate this planning problem into a CP-SAT scheduling JSON spec.

Problem:
To season baked fish, here are the steps needed.
Step 1. Rub minced garlic onto the skin (2 minutes)
Step 2. Sprinkle coarse sea salt over the top (30 seconds)
Step 3. Zest a fresh lemon (3 minutes)
Step 4. Prepare a small bowl of melted butter (4 minutes)
Step 5. Slice fresh parsley leaves (5 minutes)
Step 6. Measure out a teaspoon of dried oregano (1 minute)
Step 7. Grind black peppercorns (2 minutes)
Step 8. Dice a small shallot (6 minutes)
Step 9. Gather all spices from the pantry (10 minutes)
Step 10. Dust the fish with a pinch of paprika (30 seconds)
Step 11. Measure the olive oil (1 minute)
Step 12. Whisk the oil and citrus juices together (2 minutes)
Step 13. Combine lemon zest with herbs (2 minutes)
Step 14. Add diced shallots to the herb mix (3 minutes)
Step 15. Locate the baking sheet (1 minute)
Step 16. Soften a tablespoon of butter (5 minutes)
Step 17. Squeeze half a lime (1 minute)
Step 18. Pour the butter mixture over the fillets (1 minute)
Step 19. Chop a bunch of fresh dill (5 minutes)
Step 20. Arrange lemon slices on the fish (2 minutes)
Step 21. Select the freshest fish fillets (15 minutes)
Step 22. Pat the fish dry with paper towels (2 minutes)
Step 23. Garnish with a sprig of rosemary (30 seconds)
Step 24. Pour a splash of white wine over the tray (1 minute)
Step 25. Lightly salt the underside of the fish (30 seconds)
Step 26. Rinse the herbs under cold water (1 minute)
Step 27. Massage the herb paste into the flesh (3 minutes)
Step 28. Sprinkle cracked pepper on the tray (30 seconds)
Step 29. Mix the dill into the marinade (2 minutes)
Step 30. Peel the garlic cloves (4 minutes)
Step 31. Wash the lemon and lime (2 minutes)
Step 32. Apply a thin layer of mustard (2 minutes)
Step 33. Shake off excess water from herbs (1 minute)
Step 34. Open the bottle of white wine (1 minute)
Step 35. Line the baking sheet with parchment paper (2 minutes)
Step 36. Preheat the oven to 375 degrees (15 minutes)
Step 37. Brush the fish with olive oil (2 minutes)
Step 38. Slice a second lemon for juice (2 minutes)
Step 39. Clear the kitchen counter (10 minutes)
Step 40. Place the fish onto the prepared sheet (1 minute)
Step 41. Create a herb and butter compound (5 minutes)
Step 42. Spread lemon zest over the skin (1 minute)
Step 43. Tuck bay leaves under the fish (1 minute)
Step 44. Set aside the serving platter (2 minutes)
Step 45. Remove fish from its packaging (1 minute)
Step 46. Rinse the fish under cold water (2 minutes)
Step 47. Score the skin of the fish with a knife (3 minutes)
Step 48. Squeeze the juice of one lemon (2 minutes)
Step 49. Whisk in a pinch of cayenne pepper (30 seconds)
Step 50. Lightly oil the baking sheet (1 minute)
Step 51. Add a teaspoon of honey to the glaze (1 minute)
Step 52. Mince a small knob of ginger (5 minutes)
Step 53. Check the fish for any remaining scales (5 minutes)
Step 54. Prepare a bed of sliced onions (8 minutes)
Step 55. Top the fish with the herb mixture (2 minutes)
Step 56. Crush the garlic into a paste (3 minutes)
Step 57. Retrieve the parchment paper from the drawer (1 minute)
Step 58. Melt the remaining butter (2 minutes)
Step 59. Sharpen the kitchen knife (5 minutes)
Step 60. Inspect the fillets for bones (10 minutes)
Step 61. Mix the mustard and butter (2 minutes)
Step 62. Blend the spices into the butter (2 minutes)
Step 63. Pour the marinade over the fillets (1 minute)
Step 64. Chop the garlic finely (5 minutes)
Step 65. Slice the lemon into rounds (3 minutes)
Step 66. Organize the prep bowls (5 minutes)
Step 67. Set the timer for the oven (30 seconds)
Step 68. Clean the workspace (15 minutes)
Step 69. Whisk the final glaze (2 minutes)
Step 70. Sharpen the filleting knife (5 minutes)
Step 71. Season the edges of the fish (1 minute)
Step 72. Sanitize the cutting board (5 minutes)
Step 73. Strain the lemon juice (2 minutes)
Step 74. Prepare the side garnish (10 minutes)
Step 75. Verify the oven temperature (1 minute)
Step 76. Finely chop the oregano (4 minutes)
Step 77. Lay the fish on the bed of onions (2 minutes)
Step 78. Add a final dusting of sea salt (30 seconds)
Step 79. Sprinkle with red pepper flakes (30 seconds)
Step 80. Clean the herb stems (5 minutes)
